newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mideast conference opens amid diplomatic activity.
newsitem.headline: Mideast conference opens amid diplomatic activity.

text.p: A conference aimed at integrating the diverse economies of the Middle East opened in Cairo on Tuesday amid a flurry of diplomatic activity in the Arab-Israeli peace process.
Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak opened the third Middle East and North Africa Economic Conference after talks with U.S., Palestinian and European officials.
More than 5,000 businessmen and government officials from 92 countries are attending the three day event, which is surrounded by oppressive security.
